name: Lite YouTube embed
description: Provides an alternative field formatter for rendering YouTube videos with Paul Irish's Lite YouTube Embed library instead of the default OEmbed iframe.

suggests.oomphinc/composer-installers-extender: Needed if you want to load the library as npm-asset and placed into the 'libraries' directory.
suggests.npm-asset/lite-youtube-embed: Paul Irish's Lite YouTube Embed library as NPM asset.

project_description:
This module provides an alternative field formatter for rendering YouTube videos with Paul Irish Lite YouTube Embed library instead of the default OEmbed iframe.

 In order to allow generic usage on a remote video media bundle, that also allows videos from other providers like Vimeo, the implementation falls back to show the OEmbed iFrame on any other providers than YouTube.
